shared: site-header (template part, child override of parts/header.html)
site-footer (template part, child override of parts/footer.html)

blocks.title: Delivery Bar
blocks.behavior: Slot <select> (5 slots, default index 2) + 1-Hour Express toggle (+$20.00); writes delivery state consumed by mini-cart and checkout-fulfilment; right-side delivery note updates live; child.js

blocks.title: Mini Cart (S.Mart drawer)
blocks.behavior: Parent ai-zippy/mini-cart toggle+drawer re-skinned to S.Mart; red pill button with live total + green count badge; drawer item rows with qty stepper/remove; slot vs express picker; Checkout button navigates to /checkout/

blocks.title: Home Hero
blocks.behavior: Static; 'Next slot' floating card text filled from delivery state by child.js; CTAs link /shop/ and /about/

blocks.title: Shop by Category
blocks.behavior: Renders the 6 home-flagged product categories (logic.js CATS home:true) with tint blob + image tile; click → /shop/ filtered by category; 'View all products →' → /shop/

blocks.title: Today's Promotions
blocks.behavior: Horizontal scroll-snap scroller of 3 promo cards; middle card shows live HH:MM:SS countdown to midnight (child.js); all cards → /shop/

blocks.title: Shop Catalog (filters + grid + quickview)
blocks.behavior: Sidebar: category list with counts (All products + 7 cats, active = dark pill) and Sort by select (Most popular / Price low-high / high-low); grid: product cards with badge, category eyebrow, name, unit label ('from $X.XX' / 'N options'), strikethrough was-price, quick-add + button; card click opens quickview modal (variant buttons, specs, qty, Add to Cart with live total, POS stock line); no-results dashed panel with 'Clear filters'; reads ?q= and ?cat= query args; filtering/sorting/cart adds via child.js + Woo Store API; toast on add

blocks.title: About Story
blocks.behavior: None (static two-column with blob image composition)

blocks.title: Why S.Mart by Profitrade
blocks.behavior: None (4 static cards, numbered 01-04, content from logic.js ADV)

blocks.title: WhatsApp Bulk-Pricing Banner
blocks.behavior: CTA opens wa.me link with prefilled text (logic.js:138)

blocks.title: Contact Inquiry Form
blocks.behavior: Name/Email/Message form; submit via child.js AJAX (admin-ajax) → wp_mail; success pane with green ✓ blob, 'Message sent', 'Send another' reset

blocks.title: Checkout Fulfilment Picker
blocks.behavior: Radio cards: Delivery (3-Hour Slot, label from delivery state, Free) / 1-Hour Express (+$20.00) / Walk-in Pickup (Free, shows collect-at note); preselected from delivery-bar state; stores choice as hidden fields → saved to Woo order meta; toggles visibility of address vs pickup note alongside Woo checkout

behaviors.target: delivery state {slot}, express=false, note text, dim select when express
Woo Store API cart add + toast 'Added N × <name>' (1800ms)
cart item qty, fragments refresh, totals
selected border #FF1A1A, hidden inputs, order meta on place-order
